description: List this account's Batch jobs, newest first, each with its latest run's status and stats. Filter by status (open or closed) and type (regular or scheduled). Pass next_cursor as cursor for the next page; a page can hold fewer than limit jobs while next_cursor is still set, so keep paging until it is null. Deleted jobs are not listed.

cursor.description: next_cursor from a previous batch_list call

status.description: Only jobs with this job status

name: batch_list
